text: 茶百道在港交所公告，本公司董事会董事会注意到，香港证监会已于10月13日上午九时正起暂停本公司H股买卖。香港证监会表示，其关注本公司的首次公开发售可能曾被人为操纵，以营造对股份需求的假象。本公司董事会高度重视此事，并坚信遵守所有适用于本公司的法律及法规至关重要。因此，本公司正就该指令紧急寻求法律意见，并将努力处理及解决香港证监会关注的事项。本公司承诺全力配合香港证监会处理其任何关注事项，并将适时另行刊发公告。本公司确认，本集团的业务营运维持正常，且截至本公告日期，本集团的业务营运并无发生重大变动。
text_en: ChaPanda announced on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange that the company's board of directors notes that the Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission has suspended trading in the company's H shares from 9:00 a.m. on October 13. The Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission said it is concerned that the company's initial public offering may have been artificially manipulated to create a false appearance of demand for the shares. The company's board of directors attaches great importance to this matter and firmly believes that compliance with all laws and regulations applicable to the company is crucial. Therefore, the company is urgently seeking legal advice regarding the directive and will work to address and resolve the concerns of the Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission. The company is committed to fully cooperating with the Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission in handling any of its concerns and will publish further announcements in due course. The company confirms that the group's business operations remain normal and that as of the date of this announcement there have been no material changes in the group's business operations.
